name: BMW Industries Ltd
summary: BMW Industries Ltd. engages in the manufacture of steel items. The firm offers steel pipes, pole and transmission line towers, galvanizing line and service centers. Its products and services include poles and tubular structure, undertakes infrastructure connectivity and state highway projects, concrete roads and bridges, manufacturing towers, structural steel including angle and beams channels. The company was founded on October 21, 1981 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
